name: The Game
description: The Game is a slapstick comedy following two childhood friends, Waseem and Mazo, who along with their families are unwittingly pulled into a game of pranks and challenges orchestrated by a mysterious stranger. Starring fan favourites Hesham Maged, Chico, Moataz El Tony, and Bayoumi Fouad, the series delivers non-stop laughs as the rivalry escalates across five seasons of outrageous schemes, family chaos, and hilarious confrontations.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Mazo is released from the clinic after being cured of the game addiction, and Wasim becomes unemployed and under Israa's control after her promotion at the hotel, and Wassim watches - Isra and Jamil complain about them, discovering her involvement with Shaimaa in the game.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wassim requires Israa to return to his work at the hotel in exchange for helping her with the game against Shaima, while Mazo returns to help Shaima, and the first challenge between Wasim and Mazu begins to deliver a criminal to justice within 24 hours, and the police arrest Mazu on charges of bribing an employee.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mazu confesses to Saadoun that he is back in the game, and Wasim is forced to report Jamil’s past crimes to the police and win the first challenge, and Wasim returns to work with Malik.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Wasim discovers that he has appointed an owner in a popular hotel and convinces Mazu-Zakaria to join his team with the game, and the second challenge begins with the game, in which Mazu and Wasim must refrain from laughing for a day to win.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wasim's team competes against Mazu in an attempt to make each other laugh, and Wasim's team fails to compete after discovering Shwikar's pregnancy and Mazu wins the second challenge.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Wasim discovers that Shweikar's pregnancy that caused their loss is a lie, and Mazu establishes an educational center for laundering money for the game, and the third challenge begins, which Mazu or Wasim must marry their neighbor.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wasim and Mazu discover that Altaf left her apartment for the sake of a beautiful woman named Nisreen, and the challenge becomes to marry her, so Israa tries to convince Wassim to marry her to win the challenge, and Mazu collects information about Nisreen.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mazu tries to lure Nisreen with money, Waseem and Israa are feigning divorce in front of Nisreen, and Jamil hires a group of thugs to attack Nisreen and save Wassim for her.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Mazo and Wasim have been rivals since childhood, constantly competing with each other through challenges and pranks. As the years go by, the duo grows up, and Wasim and Mazo eventually sign a pledge in front of the police, promising not to bother each other again.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wasim spends an unexpected night with Mazo, and later receives a phone call from a mysterious person, which he believes is an attempt to spy on him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Wasim tries to look for a mobile phone that was thrown in the trash, while Mazo attempts to ruin Samar’s celebration at Wasim’s hotel.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mazo receives a message from an unknown person trying to force him and Wasim to return to their challenges, and all of Mazo’s plans to win the challenge fail.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mazo tries to do the impossible to ruin Samar’s celebration and win the challenge, and Mazo and Wasim discover that a mysterious person is trying to manipulate them into returning to the challenges.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A new challenge begins between Wasim and Mazo, and the mysterious person asks them to record a video that will get a high number of views in order to win the prize. Mazo then asks Saadoun for help, offering in return to help him marry Tahani.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Mazo begins to suspect that the mysterious person is watching him and Wasim. Wasim becomes famous through YouTube clips and grows lovable with everyone, and then Wasim and Mazo receive the new challenge in which they are supposed to betray their wives.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Mazo asks Saadoun to help him betray his wife. He enlists Tahani to carry out his plan, but then discovers that Shaimaa is under the influence of a sedative, which makes her reaction different from what he expected.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Isra catches Tahani and Wasim and accuses him of cheating. Mazo tries to prove that Wasim is not a traitor, but Isra kicks them out of the house, and Wasim wins the new competition.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The new challenge is based on perfection, where Wasim and Mazo must remain flawless in order to win the competition. Mazo confesses about his classmates to the principal in order to demonstrate his perfection, and he wins the competition.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Mazo and Wasim receive a new challenge, in which they must kidnap a child and demand a ransom in order for one of them to win the competition. Mazo kidnaps Akram, Wasim’s son, and demands a ransom from him.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Wasim kidnaps Karim, Mazo’s son, and demands a ransom for the competition. Akram and Karim are returned to their fathers, and the mysterious man organizes a new challenge: to steal a painting and get rid of it from the abandoned house number 23.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Wasim and Mazo compete in a race to steal the painting. They come up with a plan to break into the house and steal it in disguise. Wasim disguises himself as a police officer, manages to reach the painting, burns it, and wins the challenge.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Wasim is arrested for impersonating a police officer, and Shaimaa discovers that Mazo has returned to gambling. The eighth mission in the game begins, with the prize being one million pounds for whoever manages to spend the night at the Agouza Police Station.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Wasim is arrested and taken to the Agouza Police Station, but he discovers that Officer Noubtegy is an old childhood friend and is released each time. Meanwhile, Mazo is arrested on charges of stealing a mobile phone.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Wasim steals Mazo’s phone and discovers that the ninth mission involves appearing with Sherif Amer on a television show. Mazo tries to learn about the mission from Wasim, but he misleads him.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Mazo walks all the way to Ain Sokhna to carry out the fake mission that Wasim told him about. Wasim tries to appear with Sherif Amer, but Mazo becomes famous, appears on the show with Sherif Amer, and wins the prize.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Mazo discovers that Wasim stole his phone and takes it back. Shaimaa uncovers the secret of the game, and Mazo and Wasim try to quit, but the mysterious man threatens them with prison. He announces that the winner of the game will receive one million dollars, while the loser will be jailed.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Mazo and Wasim receive two bags, marking the start of the tenth challenge, which involves delivering a bag containing drugs to a man named Rashad. Shaimaa and Mazo break into a mobile company to find Rashad’s phone number and address, and Mazo and Shaimaa win the challenge.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: A new challenge begins in the game, where the task is to assemble a team of six people in front of the Adrenaline Park. The two teams compete in a color-gun game, and Wasim and his team win the challenge.
